S21-Q005: Option 1
Clarification: S21 has no automatic rollover for open positions in V1. Fresh entries follow approved contract-selection rules. Open positions follow verified EOD/carry and carried-position lifecycle rules. If a position would continue into an unsupported expiry state, fail closed and require operator/user decision; do not close old and open new automatically.
